messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — we received the external pen test intake PDF. Assessor labelled 6 medium + 2 high, but retest scope centers on RBAC changes, KMS decrypt scope, and missing audit exports. Need to designate evidence owner and lock a retest window.
jonathan: Can we run a dry-run Thursday to validate ephemeral role issuance and KMS grant flow before handing anything off? I want to confirm session policies and encryption-context constraints.
kevin: Infra good for Thursday AM. Prefer to implement ephemeral roles via automation (no manual console steps). We should avoid adding long-lived policies to any prod role.
sara: For packaging: presigned S3 links (7d expiry) + gzipped CloudTrail/app logs. Include a README with SHA256 digests and mapping from finding -> file path. Assessors asked specifically for KMS-encrypted exports they can decrypt.
maria: We must not give decrypt on our primary prod keys. Plan: create a scoped key alias (assessor-scope) and grant Decrypt to temporary role for limited prefixes only.
jonathan: Draft approach: provision IAM role `assessor-temp-<ts>` with assume_role allowed for the assessor AWS account; attach inline session policy restricting S3 prefixes and require `kms:EncryptionContext` matching `purpose:assessor-review`. Grant KMS Decrypt via grant bound to that role, lifetime 72h.
kevin: Implementation snippet (conceptual):
```
# terraform conceptual
resource "aws_iam_role" "assessor_temp" {
  name = "assessor-temp-${timestamp}"
}
resource "aws_kms_grant" "assessor" {
  grantee_principal = aws_iam_role.assessor_temp.arn
  operations = ["Decrypt"]
  constraints = { "EncryptionContextSubset" = { "purpose" = "assessor-review" } }
}
```
We'll rotate/revoke the grant immediately after the window.
sec-bot: Policy check: any KMS grant must include ticket tag `pt:grant=true`. If scope expands, file in #incidents per workflow.
maria: Who owns the ticket to track remediation -> evidence -> retest? Need single source of truth.
jonathan: I'll own it. Ticket checklist: RBAC PR -> apply -> KMS grant -> export logs -> compute digests -> share presigned links (with legal NDA attached) -> retest calendar invite -> post-retest regression.
sara: Export guidance: include CloudTrail event lookup for the relevant time ranges and app audit logs correlated by request IDs. Provide gzipped JSON and a CSV mapping (finding_id, file, correlation_ids). Use `aws cloudtrail lookup-events` for CloudTrail.
kevin: Retention/export window: 30 days around the timestamps in the report unless assessor requests otherwise. If SIEM retention is less, snapshot raw events now.
oncall-ops: Tentatively reserving Fri 09:00-12:00 PT as primary retest slot and Mon 14:00-17:00 PT fallback. Will post calendar invites once ticket exists.
maria: Legal requirement: updated NDA addendum must be signed and attached before any presigned links shared. SecOps to confirm legal stamp.
sec-bot: Legal verification automation: attach signed PDF to ticket; sec-bot will annotate `legal:ok`. No access will be granted without that annotation.
jonathan: For evidence immutability, include SHA256 digests and a signed header (generator identity + UTC timestamp). Example digest script: `for f in *.json.gz; do sha256sum "${f}" >> evidence-digests.txt; done` — include tz info in header.
sara: Also ensure each exported log file includes the ingestion timestamp in metadata and the correlation IDs. I'll add that to README.
maria: Post-retest: run automated regression against the original prompt/eval set and snapshot outputs. Add this to the ticket as a required step.
kevin: One ops note: when creating the KMS grant, ensure constraints prevent wildcard EncryptionContext. Use explicit context keys/values. Also ensure CloudTrail logs show the grant creation event for audit.
oncall-ops: I'll coordinate with oncall to have someone available during the retest window for quick rollback if access misbehaves.
jonathan: I'll open the ticket now (will be ticket 12897). I'll include the dry-run checklist and tag @kevin, @sara, @oncall-ops, and legal.
maria: Action items recap: jonathan -> open ticket + RBAC PR draft; kevin -> KMS grant playbook + dry-run; sara -> prepare exports, README, digests; oncall-ops -> calendar invites + standby; sec-bot/legal -> verify NDA. Confirm by EOD. :thumbsup:
jonathan: Confirmed, starting PR and ticket.
kevin: Confirmed, will run dry-run and upload logs.
sara: Confirmed, will package artifacts and include digest file.
oncall-ops: Confirmed, will post invites after ticket creation.
sec-bot: Automated checks will run on PR and ticket creation; remember `pt:grant=true` tag.
maria: Thanks everyone. I'll track ticket 12897 and follow up after PR lands.
messages_summary: Owners assigned, KMS grant plan with constrained decrypt, presigned evidence exports, NDA gating, retest windows reserved, ticket 12897 to track work
